lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense distribution of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters organized into approximately five horizontal rows across the visible flank, with the largest and highest-intensity blobs concentrated in the anterior-superior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs on the anterior portion of the flank, forming a grid-like arrangement of high-luminance nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient, with high-luminance pixels on the upper edge transitioning into dark shadowed pixels below.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras (Echeneidae) are visible as elongated dark silhouettes swimming ventrally to the pectoral fin and attached to its posterior distal edge.
